summary: Verified from Kymco and SYM official November 2026 pages (valid to 30 Nov): headline gasoline prices of NT$45,600 (GP125), 47,500 (Laddi 115) and 48,200 (新豪邁 drum) are scrap-and-replace prices. With nothing to scrap, our arithmetic gives about NT$50,500, 51,000 and 53,500. Best sellers cost more: SYM 迪爵 about NT$59,000 and 全新迪爵 about NT$61,500 without scrapping (derived; SYM list prices appear to include about NT$2,000 plate insurance), Yamaha Jog 125 lists NT$66,000 (NT$46,700 with scrap, per Yamaha via NOWnews). The NT$2,000 goods-tax cut for any new scooter of 150cc or less, plus up to NT$4,000 more for scrapping, applies to gasoline too. Whether it runs to 2030 was only reported, not confirmed. Official fuel economy is 57-61 km/L (65.6 hybrid-assist); SYM's example is about NT$133 a month at 28.9 NTD/L (March 2026) for 279 km. Dealer promos reset monthly; 2027 unknown. Compulsory insurance NT$658 a year (older rate table). Annual road fee and plate fee amounts are unverified.
